description: This file defines a module for formatting webpack error and warning messages, including functions to clean up and interpret error messages, particularly syntax errors, and to produce a user-friendly output.

methods.name: isLikelyASyntaxError
methods.description: Determines if a message is likely a syntax error based on its content.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Cleans and formats individual webpack error or warning messages for better readability.

methods.name: formatWebpackMessages
methods.description: Formats the entire webpack error and warning JSON object into cleaned, user-friendly messages.
